title: 2896. Apply Operations to Make Two Strings Equal

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations: - Choose i = 3 and apply the second operation. The resulting string is s1 = "1101111000". - Choose i = 4 and apply the second operation. The resulting string is s1 = "1101001000". - Choose i = 0 and j = 8 and apply the first operation. The resulting string is s1 = "0101001010" = s2. The total cost is 1 + 1 + 2 = 4. It can be shown that it is the minimum cost possible.
It is not possible to make the two strings equal.
